# Getting started

> Minimal stub, added when this package adopted hey_packager 0.1.7 (whose
> `bin/check` requires the docs set). The authoritative text is the
> top-level [README.md](../README.md).

`docs/examples/basic.hey` builds Checkout and Billing Portal session
parameters without any network access. The opt-in sandbox HTTP probe is
described in the top-level README.
